title: Relational state organization cell: governed visitor experiment with zero integration effect (PREREG-RS-0001 v0.3.1)
created_from: GAP-0009 recommended first slice; scientific object frozen in PREREG-RS-0001 v0.3.1 (amended after reviewing-executor reviews R1, R2 and R3) before this plan was amended
objective: Obtain one controlled, paired, preregistered measurement of whether reorganizing an information-equivalent clue set into explicit relational state (RM-v0) changes the reasoning accuracy of an unchanged LLM relative to a flat rendering (FLAT-v0) of the same clues, with no automatic inference, propagation or query-dependent selection in either arm, and record the result so that GAP-0009 can close as positive, negative or inconclusive.
proposed_change: Add an experiment package ai_lab/experiments/relational_state/ (model, generator, oracle, depth, arm1, arm2, equivalence, scoring, runner) with tests under tests/experiments/relational_state/, and create the artifact family docs/research/experiments/ holding docs/research/experiments/relational_state/ with the preregistration, campaign manifest, campaign_execution_profile, one JSONL per stage, and the calibration, pilot and main-campaign reports. Every module except runner.py is standard-library-only; runner.py alone imports ai_lab.providers.*; the constant INTEGRATION_EFFECT = 'none' is defined in the package and serialized into every run artifact. Provenance is self-contained (Option S): the runner writes no InvocationRecords and no host capture path is widened. No existing module, default, prompt path, context-selection behaviour or self-model capability is modified.
scope: S1. Create docs/research/experiments/ as a new documentation-artifact family (first instance: relational_state/), with a README stating the family's purpose and that entries are preregistered experiments, not specifications. This is a documentation-architecture change and is authorized here explicitly.

S2. Place PREREG-RS-0001 (as amended after reviewing-executor review) under docs/research/experiments/relational_state/. The preregistration is the frozen scientific object; the code implements it and may not redefine it.

S3. Zero-API implementation: generator (declared family, disjoint neutral handle lists, constructed unique/two-solution instances, no descriptor-based deduplication), exhaustive oracle, PROP-RS-0 synchronous-wave propagator and depth labeller (EQUAL/NOT_EQUAL clue grammar only), FLAT-v0 and RM-v0 serializers, decoder, admission auditor enforcing A1-A6 and query independence, scorer, the Lan-DeMets O'Brien-Fleming spending routine (critical values from frozen spending times t_k = n_k / N_req), and the finite-sample simulation check of the implemented staged paired-Wald procedure at Delta = delta over the preregistered q grid and attainable schedules (pass: familywise error <= 0.05 + 0.01; failure is a STOP). All with tests; all green before S4 begins.

S4. Runner: the only module importing ai_lab.providers.*; resolves and writes campaign_execution_profile.json before the first call and aborts on any mismatch; runs each trial's two arms back-to-back in fresh contexts with SHA-256(trial_id)-parity arm order and a seeded trial order; writes one JSONL per stage (git commit and tree state, profile reference, puzzle_id, trial_id, arm, serializer version, prompt SHA-256, raw response, response SHA-256, parsed output, score, timestamps, provider outcome and token counts, INTEGRATION_EFFECT = 'none') and enters each completed stage's digest in the campaign manifest; implements the pilot blinding sequence (b+c -> N_req, look schedule t_k and Lan-DeMets critical values z_k -> manifest hash -> unlock direction) and the staged-look adjudication using the manifest-frozen z_k; blocks of 240 with a final balanced partial block.

S5. Calibration (non-evidential, Arm 1 only, 10 unique + 10 ambiguous per populated (n,d)) per PREREG-RS-0001 section 8.1 with the deterministic triple-selection rule and STOP; calibration report filed under docs/research/experiments/relational_state/.

S6. Pipeline pilot (non-evidential, both arms, 10 per stratum, quarantined identifiers) per section 8.2, including the direction-blinded discordance estimate q, the frozen N_req (1200 <= N <= 2616; STOP above 2616 before direction is displayed) and the look schedule.

S7. Main campaign: N_req trials in balanced blocks of 240 (10 per stratum; final balanced partial block when necessary), 2N calls, primary subject, adjudicated only at the preregistered looks by paired-Wald CI against the operator-owned SESOI (delta = 0.03, power alternative 0.06); each stage JSONL hashed into the manifest before the next starts; main-campaign report filed; GAP-0009 closure recorded as POSITIVE, NEGATIVE or INCONCLUSIVE at the closing look.
non_goals: Any runtime use of relational state in AI-Lab: no context selection, context-pack, graph-neighbourhood, memory-write or provider-routing change (GAP-0002 territory untouched).

Arm 3 (automatic propagation), Arm 4 as an experimental arm, erasure/error/ambiguity-repair tests, streaming clue delivery, synergy measurement, residual or cycle machinery, query projection. Each is a candidate later cell.
Establishing any AI-Lab capability from a positive result; a capability record requires its own GAP, PLAN and warrant.
Testing the relational-memory architecture of the RTG thread. This plan tests organization alone.
The replication on the secondary subject is scheduled after the primary closes and is filed as a rider, not as part of the primary closure.
constraints: Implementation is authorized only within the scope admitted by a future admission warrant; any expansion requires a separate proposed and admitted plan.
INTEGRATION_EFFECT = 'none': the package changes no AI-Lab runtime behaviour, default, prompt path or self-model capability, and the constant is serialized into every run artifact.

Import membrane, two tiers: every module under ai_lab/experiments/relational_state/ except runner.py is standard-library-only; runner.py alone may import ai_lab.providers.*; nothing imports ai_lab.documentation or any context-selection / graph-neighbourhood module. A test asserts both tiers.

Admission invariants A1 (Decode(Render_1(C)) = C), A2 (Decode(Render_2(C)) = C), A3 (Decode(Render_1(C)) = Decode(Render_2(C))), A4 (InferenceDerivedFacts(Render_2(C)) is empty: RM-v0 may add deterministic ID-only structural indexing, never semantic entailment) and A6 (every clue body occurs exactly once per rendering; only clue IDs recur in the index) are enforced automatically for every instance before any provider call; failing instances are excluded and logged with the failing invariant.

A5 degenerate-identity guard: two independently generated handles with identical visible descriptors remain distinct through generation, rendering and decoding; no component performs R_uv = I => Glue(u, v). Enforced by test.
Query independence: the query names the target and alters nothing in either rendering; enforced by a test that renders one instance under every target and asserts byte-identical state blocks.
Zero-API first: S3 is complete and green before any provider-invoking code exists; provider tokens are not used for debugging.

Option S: no InvocationRecords are written and CAPTURE_PATHS is not modified; the runner's stage JSONL retains prompt digest, raw response, response digest, resolved profile and provider outcome, and each completed stage digest is entered in the campaign manifest. No direct SDK calls: providers are reached only through ai_lab.providers adapters.

The preregistration is frozen at admission; any deviation during execution is recorded as an amendment before the affected step runs, and analyses not preregistered are labelled EXPLORATORY and may not close GAP-0009.
The harness author is not the sole verifier: the reviewing executor reviews the equivalence auditor, oracle, depth labeller and scorer tests against PREREG-RS-0001 before S4 begins.
Generated instances only; no instance is drawn from any published puzzle corpus. Handle and item vocabularies are neutral and disjoint.

Execution profile (model, effort, max output tokens, temperature/seed or provider_default) is resolved and written to campaign_execution_profile.json before the first call; every capture must match it.
Paired execution: each trial's two arms run back-to-back in fresh contexts; arm order by SHA-256(trial_id) parity; trial order by recorded campaign_seed. Never all-Arm-1-then-all-Arm-2.

Operator-owned frozen values: primary subject gpt-5.6-terra, replication claude-sonnet-5; SESOI delta = 0.03 with power alternative 0.06; calibration window [0.30, 0.80], centre 0.55, smaller-n tie-break; Option S capture; N_min = 1200, N_max = 2616; stage size 240 with looks after stages 3, 6, 9 and at N_req. None may be changed after calibration results are seen.

Sample size: N_req = ceil(q (z_.975 + z_.80)^2 / (0.06 - 0.03)^2), rounded up to a multiple of 24, with q the pilot's direction-blinded discordant-pair rate; floored at 1200; STOP if above 2616. Interim adjudication only at preregistered looks; spending time t_k = n_k / N_req is a planned proxy with no data-dependent re-timing; critical values z_k from Lan-DeMets O'Brien-Fleming spending alpha(t) = 2[1 - Phi(z_.975 / sqrt(t))] computed by a tested deterministic routine and frozen in the manifest before stage 1; no hard-coded multipliers in the operative rule; between looks only direction-blinded quantities are displayed; no extension beyond N_max within this cell.

Finite-sample statistical check is a zero-API STOP gate: the implemented staged procedure is simulated at Delta = delta = 0.03 over q in {0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40} and all attainable schedules with >= 20,000 seeded replications per cell; if the probability of ever classifying POSITIVE or NEGATIVE incorrectly exceeds 0.06 in any cell, the statistical routine is amended before any provider call. The claim is that spending targets alpha = 0.05 and simulation verifies finite-sample behaviour, not exact control by construction.
success_criteria: ZERO-API GREEN. Generator, oracle, depth labeller, serializers, decoder, admission auditor and scorer pass their tests, including A1-A6, query independence the two-tier import membrane, the spending routine and the finite-sample simulation check (pass in every cell), and the full existing suite remains green, before the runner exists.

CAPTURE (Option S). Every provider call in calibration, pilot and main campaign has a stage-JSONL row with prompt SHA-256, raw response, response SHA-256, resolved profile reference and provider outcome; every completed stage digest appears in the campaign manifest; each run artifact carries INTEGRATION_EFFECT = 'none'; the campaign_execution_profile matches every call; docs/invocations/ is unchanged by this plan.
CALIBRATION DECISION. A calibration report exists and either selects N_main by the preregistered rule or records STOP with the accuracy surface; a STOP does not count as a failure of this plan.

MAIN CAMPAIGN. If launched: staged execution per the preregistration, paired-Wald CI at each preregistered look with the manifest-frozen Lan-DeMets critical value, adjudication against delta = 0.03, and GAP-0009 closure recorded as POSITIVE, NEGATIVE or INCONCLUSIVE at the closing look with the interval, the multiplier and N at that look.

BOUNDARY. The two-tier import-membrane test passes and no diff outside ai_lab/experiments/relational_state/, tests/experiments/relational_state/ and docs/research/experiments/ exists in the implementing commits, except self-model index rebuilds. ai_lab/providers/invocation_record.py and docs/invocations/ are untouched.
expected_outputs: Calibration report, pilot report and (if launched) main-campaign report under docs/research/experiments/relational_state/, plus campaign_execution_profile.json, one campaign manifest with per-stage digests, and one JSONL per stage; every artifact carries the serialized INTEGRATION_EFFECT.
A VERIFY record for the zero-API stage and a VERIFY record for the campaign stage.
GAP-0009 updated with its closure form and evidence.
rationale: F(-1): both outcomes change a sentence. Positive retains H_RS in the declared scope and makes a propagation cell decision-relevant; negative records organization alone as insufficient in that scope. Inconclusive changes nothing and is reported as such.

The provider adapters already exist (CAP-0015 lineage) and are reused unchanged. The governed capture path is not reused: it admits only scripts/compare_providers.py and writes one tracked file per call, so inheriting it would require a host-warrant widening and thousands of permanent records; the cell instead records self-contained content-addressed provenance and leaves host governance untouched.

The diagnostic-only evaluators established the pattern of an activity that lives in the repository without changing its behaviour (SELECTION_EFFECT = 'none'); this plan reuses that pattern so the experiment can be governed without becoming a feature.
The docs/research/experiments/ family was anticipated by P-0001 and never created; creating it through an explicit scope item avoids introducing documentation architecture as a side effect.

Staged execution with preregistered repeated-CI looks lets the operator run the campaign incrementally and stop early on a valid POSITIVE or NEGATIVE, or halt for budget with an honest INCONCLUSIVE, without the garden of forking paths that ad-hoc extension would create.
risk: Inference leakage into Arm 2 would make the primary result forced rather than measured; a ceiling family would make it non-discriminating; either could be mistaken for evidence. A positive result could be misread as a capability or as support for the wider relational-memory architecture; a negative result could be inflated into a general refutation. Provider non-determinism adds noise to a paired design so per-stratum conclusions are underpowered and only the pooled primary endpoint bears on closure. Under Option S the cell has no AI-Lab InvocationRecords; its provenance is only as good as the stage JSONL and manifest digests. Interim looks add a small risk of stopping on noise, bounded by the spending function.
mitigation: Automated per-instance admission invariants A1-A6 (A6 removes repetition-as-emphasis) and the query-independence test address leakage; the calibration STOP addresses non-discrimination; INTEGRATION_EFFECT = 'none', the import-boundary test and the non-goals address capability misreading; the preregistered SESOI, two-sided test and scope wording address inflation in both directions; per-stratum results are reported as secondary only; pilot-based sample-size re-estimation reads only the direction-blinded discordance rate; stage JSONLs are hashed into the manifest before the next stage starts; looks are preregistered with Lan-DeMets O'Brien-Fleming spending at frozen spending times, and the implemented paired-Wald procedure is simulation-checked at the boundary case before any provider call.
